limits: Single operator/exact reviewed script required. There is no filesystem lock or automatic post-replace rollback; source/target inode, stable metadata and hashes are rechecked before replacement.

Atime is observed per operation; these preflight hash/ACL/xattr reads may advance atime. The clone restores the atime sampled before that replacement, not historical inventory atime. Concurrent access after that sample is not protected by a lock.
Canonical sources have no explicit writes in the operation; read-induced access-time changes remain possible. Inode/ctime/birth metadata can change for replaced targets.
Same-volume metadata and cp -c invocation are verified; extent sharing or actual reclaimed disk space is not proven by this preflight. No durability or uninterrupted-operation guarantee is inferred.
Only exact inventory candidates and named receipt/seal/prior-plan files were read. This does not extend any mathematical audit window.

child_static_review.scope: Only the three authorized inventory/script temporary files; no project reads or operation execution.
child_static_review.limits: No lock or automatic rollback; exact script and single operator required.
